scope: Appendix E Revit family content, modeling hygiene, and LOD/LOI governance

sources.title: Revit Modeling Standards and Guidelines
sources.notes: The L6 modeling instruction already covered information need, reusable content, in-place restrictions, groups/assemblies, and linked/workshared model strategy. Round 004 adds the machine-readable family-content/exception layer and conformance coverage.

sources.title: Family Naming Standards and Principles for TAIT BIM
sources.notes: Family naming authority already exists in L4. Round 004 connects naming to reusable-content identity, library provenance, parameters, and change control without inventing a family library catalogue.

sources.title: LOD & LOI — Level of Development and Level of Information
sources.notes: LOD/LOI authority already exists in current main. Round 004 references it as the information-need authority for family/model content; no source numeric or phase-specific requirements are newly promoted.
